findings.title: Required source lint can fail while operator exits0
findings.proof: Each actual git diff --check exit is appended and all_source_clean computed, but neither nonzero lint nor false all_source_clean changes stopped/final status. Final condition only checks stopped/8runtimegroups/allgroup exits.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain every lint exit/raw output, then classify any nonzero required source lint as explicit failure and make final validation exit nonzero. Do not change product/fixtures or treat source-lint RED as benign raw-log whitespace.

findings.title: Success omits final global360s check after finalization work
findings.proof: remaining>1 precedes persist/capacity/full output-member hashing/seal write/print. No fresh final elapsed/deadline check participates in exit144, so that work can consume remaining time and still emit0.
findings.minimal_fix: Keep same new prospective origin and360s ceiling; reserve sufficient finite finalization work, and use a fresh actual post-finalization clock to deny success on overrun. Retain actual overrun time/nonzero outcome; no clipping/reset/refund/resumed groups or hardRT guarantee.
